faq_order_how_to: How to place an order on OMGNICE?
faq_order_how_to.desc: Easily place an order by selecting your favorite drinks and tapping the 'Buy Now' button.
faq_order_cancel: How can I cancel my order?
faq_order_cancel.desc: Orders can be cancelled within 10 minutes or if not approved after 30 minutes.
faq_order_schedule: Can I schedule an order for later?
faq_order_schedule.desc: Yes, you can choose a preferred delivery time at checkout.
faq_shipping_time.desc: Standard delivery within 1–2 days. Some specialty drinks may take longer to prepare.
faq_shipping_track: Where can I track my order?
faq_shipping_track.desc: Track your order in the 'My Orders' section in the app.
faq_shipping_offhours: Do you deliver outside office hours?
faq_shipping_offhours.desc: Yes, we support evening and weekend deliveries in selected areas.
faq_payment_methods.desc: We support Cash on Delivery, MoMo, ZaloPay, and PayOS.
faq_payment_secure: Is payment safe? Do you store card info?
faq_payment_secure.desc: All transactions are encrypted. We never store your card details.
faq_product_diet: Are OMGNICE drinks suitable for diet/healthy lifestyles?
faq_product_diet.desc: Yes. We offer low-sugar, vegan, and functional health drinks.
faq_product_options: Do you have sugar-free or caffeine-free options?
faq_product_options.desc: Yes, filter your preferences when browsing products.
faq_promo_newuser.desc: Yes! Enjoy exclusive offers when you register your first account.
faq_promo_apply: How to use promo codes or vouchers?
faq_promo_apply.desc: Enter the code at checkout. Make sure it's still valid!
faq_support_contact: How can I contact OMGNICE support?
faq_support_contact.desc: Reach us via hotline, email, or chat in the app.
faq_support_return: Can I return a product if it's wrong or damaged?
faq_support_return.desc: We accept returns only for errors or damage, within 3 days of receipt.
faq_account_required: Do I need an account to order?
faq_account_required.desc: Yes. A free account is required to track your orders and receive offers.
faq_account_loyalty: Does OMGNICE have a membership program?
faq_account_loyalty.desc: Yes. Earn points on every order and redeem rewards as a member.
